annotations.title: Write a cover letter for a job

description: Write the candidate's cover letter for one job with TrueInterview's cover-letter writer (the letter alone; generate_application_documents adds the tailored résumé in the same call), grounded in their résumé and the posting, checked for invented facts and stock phrases. Give exactly one of job_id, application_id, or job_description with company and role; instruction is the candidate's own steer ("mention my Kafka migration"). An AI model writes it (Anthropic's Claude, with DeepSeek through OpenRouter as the fallback). It uses the candidate's monthly writing allowance. Show the candidate the letter before it goes anywhere.

instruction.description: The candidate's own steer, e.g. "mention my Kafka migration".

job_description.description: The posting's text, for a job outside the catalog.

job_id.description: An id from search_jobs or recommend_jobs.

name: write_cover_letter
